skill.name: Review and Editing Specialist Agent Initialization
skill.description: Initialize a Review and Editing Specialist agent with web search, Serper Dev, and file read tools configured to refine job postings for clarity, grammar, engagement, and alignment with company values.
skill.skill_body:
Initialize a Review and Editing Specialist agent with role, goal, tools, and backstory. Assign web_search_tool, serper_dev_tool, and file_read_tool. Set role to 'Review and Editing Specialist', goal to review for clarity, engagement, grammatical accuracy, and company value alignment. Provide backstory emphasizing meticulous editing and attention to detail. Enable verbose output.

## Objective

Initialize review agent with appropriate role, goal, tools, and backstory for quality assurance and refinement
## Applicable Signals

- Draft job posting completed and ready for review
- Final phase of job description workflow initiated
- Quality assurance and refinement needed before publication

## Contraindications

- Draft posting not yet completed
- Review phase explicitly skipped in workflow
- No editing or refinement needed
- Tools not available or not initialized

## Intervention Moves

- Instantiate Agent class with Review and Editing Specialist role
- Attach web_search_tool, serper_dev_tool, and file_read_tool
- Set goal to review for clarity, engagement, grammar, and company value alignment
- Configure backstory emphasizing editorial expertise and attention to detail
- Enable verbose mode for execution transparency

## Workflow Steps

- Verify all three tools (web_search_tool, serper_dev_tool, file_read_tool) are pre-instantiated
- Confirm Agent class is available in execution environment
- Instantiate Agent with Review and Editing Specialist configuration
- Attach all three tools to agent instance
- Set verbose flag to True
- Return instantiated agent ready for execution

## Constraints

- All three tools (web_search_tool, serper_dev_tool, file_read_tool) must be pre-instantiated
- Agent class must be available in execution environment
- Verbose flag should be set to True for debugging and monitoring

## Cautions

- Ensure file_read_tool is configured with correct file path before agent instantiation
- Review agent should execute after research and writer agents complete their phases
- Tool availability and permissions must be verified before agent initialization

## Output Contract

- Instantiated Agent object with Review and Editing Specialist role, all three tools configured and attached, ready to execute refinement tasks on job posting draft
